status.description: Select a new status for this character. Some transitions may be restricted.

transitions.lockedToReady: Unlocking this character will re-enable profile edits. Are you sure you want to do this during or after an event?
transitions.readyToDraft: Returning the character to Draft status.
transitions.blocked: Invalid transition. Must be Ready before it can be Locked.

status.confirmUnlock: I understand the risks of unlocking this character.

descriptions.notesPrivacy: These notes are never visible to the assigned player.
